title: Aries Zodiac Sign: Personality, Love, Career & Compatibility
intro: Aries (March 21 – April 19) opens the zodiac year, and it shows. Ruled by Mars and powered by fire, Aries is the sign of beginnings: brave, quick, honest and always ready for the next adventure.
personality: Aries people live in the present tense. They act first and plan on the way, which makes them natural starters and fearless problem-solvers. Their energy is contagious, their opinions are clear, and they rarely hide what they feel. Under the bold surface there is a big, simple heart that loves fairness and hates games. They get bored easily, so variety, sport and friendly competition keep them happy.
love: In love, Aries chases with passion and loves the thrill of a new connection. They want a partner who can keep up, laugh with them and give them space to be themselves. Jealousy and long silences are hard for them; honest talk and shared adventures keep the flame alive.
career: Aries shines where speed and initiative matter: starting projects, sales, sports, emergency work, entrepreneurship and any role with clear goals. They work best with freedom to lead and quick feedback.
friendship: As a friend, Aries is the one who says 'let's go!' Loyal and protective, they defend their people fiercely and always bring the fun.

faq.q: What is the Aries personality like?
faq.ans: Aries is brave, energetic, honest and competitive, with a strong drive to start new things.

faq.q: Who is Aries most compatible with?
faq.ans: Aries usually gets along best with Leo, Sagittarius and Gemini, who match its energy and love of adventure.

faq.q: What is the lucky color of Aries?
faq.ans: Red is the classic lucky color for Aries, reflecting its fiery ruling planet Mars.
